description: NaCdVO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmcm space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O²⁻ atoms. There are two shorter (2.25 Å) and two longer (2.44 Å) Na-O bond lengths. V⁵⁺ is bonded to four O²⁻ atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six equivalent CdO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-53°. There are two shorter (1.69 Å) and two longer (1.75 Å) V-O bond lengths. Cd²⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form CdO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent CdO₆ octahedra. There are two shorter (2.25 Å) and four longer (2.34 Å) Cd-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O²⁻ sites. In the first O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na¹⁺, one V⁵⁺, and two equivalent Cd²⁺ atoms. In the second O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na¹⁺, one V⁵⁺, and one Cd²⁺ atom.
